notes: Opus threads spend the accounts whose Fable window is gone and leave the fresh ones to Fable. aliax-core 6e7a1f8: a scoped pick for a model without a scoped cap leads with the least Fable room (a full, unlifted window first; absent or lifted is full room), then the soonest weekly reset, then usedPercent; Fable keeps room-required-and-soonest-reset; a lifted window (reset in the past) sorts as unknown instead of first on its stale resetsAt; scopedSpent names the class. chooseAccount (accountRouting.ts) keeps the sticky account while it has room unless it is outclassed: the current account's Fable window has room (it reset) and the best pick's is spent, in which case the thread takes the best pick. Only that class change moves a thread, never a usedPercent shift between two accounts of the same class, so nothing churns per snapshot. SessionRegistry.refreshAccount already drops a live process whose pick moved (the next send respawns there; resume keeps the conversation, the prompt cache is lost) and leaves mid-turn threads alone. The reset path is intact when temp-code owns the gateway: AccountsService.armReset marks the reset accounts stale and rebuilds, the snapshot reaches refreshAccounts through onChange, and a reset window counts as fresh from the moment its resetsAt passes. Tests: accountRouting.test.ts (leave for spent, Fable stays, spent-and-out does not pull, pin holds), sessions-limits.test.ts (an idle Opus thread moves when A's Fable window resets and respawns on B, a Fable thread on A stays, nothing moves without another account with room, mid-turn untouched).
